summary.text: Judi Lanza is a Democratic former state representative and registered nurse seeking to return to the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Judi Lanza graduated from West High School, earned a degree from the Catholic Medical Center School of Nursing and a bachelor's in nursing from the University of New Hampshire, and has worked as a registered nurse.
Lanza ran for Hillsborough 6 in 2018 and lost the general election.
Lanza won Hillsborough 29 in 2022, served in the House from 2022 to 2024, and sat on the House Judiciary Committee in 2023-2024.
Lanza lost the 2024 re-election bid and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
